text:
alex: Created RC candidate for 1.14.0 — tag `v1.14.0-rc.1`. Build passed CI but we hit a flaky smoke on image-service in staging, see deploy-bot output below. Can we triage quickly?

deploy-bot: build 1.14.0-rc.1 completed · artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/1.14.0-rc.1 · e2e: started · smoke: failed on staging-image-01 :rotating_light:

maria: I saw that failure in the e2e dashboard. Stack shows 502 from image-service when under ~30 RPS. Looks like recent redis client bump might be related.

ryan: I can take a look. Quick question — are we able to pin back the redis client in the RC? If so I can cut a patch and create rc.2.

sylvia: We should not promote rc.1 to canary if the image-service is flaky. Suggest we pin the dependency and run a smoke cycle.

alex: Agreed. Ryan, please create a new branch and a patch release. Use this workflow: `git checkout -b rc/1.14.0-pin-redis && make changelog && ./scripts/release/prepare_rc.sh v1.14.0-rc.2`

ryan: On it. Patch branch pushed: `rc/1.14.0-pin-redis` — diff summary: pinned `redis-client` 2.4.1 -> 2.4.0, added a short note in CHANGELOG about the pin. Building rc.2 now.

deploy-bot: build 1.14.0-rc.2 started · ci/units: pass · ci/integration: pass · smoke: queued

qa-bot: smoke tests for 1.14.0-rc.2 in staging started (run id: smoke-2026-03-20-09).

jen: Heads-up — we have a change window at 16:00 UTC today. If we want to promote to prod today, we need sign-off by 15:15 UTC for canary rollout. Otherwise schedule for next window.

maria: What's the plan for rollout? Can we do 5% canary with automatic 30-min observation and auto-rollback on error rate >1%?

alex: Yes. Proposed rollout policy: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m observation at each step, auto-rollback thresholds: error_rate > 1% OR latency P95 increase > 20%.

ryan: Smoke finished: PASS on staging-image-01,+02,+03. E2E quick pass looks clean. I also validated the redis fix locally.

sylvia: I reviewed the CHANGELOG and release notes draft. Added a note about the redis pin and the reason. Please include the external-facing blurb about improved CDN behavior.

alex: I've updated the release notes here: https://docs.internal/releases/1.14.0-rc.2.md — please review.

maria: LGTM from security side. No new permissions or secrets.

jen: Oncall approves the canary for the window if prod dashboards are green at start. I'll start the canary run at 16:05 UTC.

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled: v1.14.0-rc.2 -> prod (canary 5%). rollout policy: 5/25/100, observation: 30m each. Triggered by alex at 16:05 UTC.

alex: Starting canary now. Monitoring links: Grafana (latency, errors), Sentry (exceptions), Tracing (request flows).

qa-bot: smoke in prod canary group passed. No regressions detected in image endpoints for the canary subset.

ryan: Can confirm no new 5xx spikes in the canary logs. Latency stable.

deploy-bot: rollout progressed: 5% -> 25% (16:40 UTC). No automatic rollback triggered.

sylvia: Running a quick sanity check on downstream services — all looks nominal. :thumbsup:

maria: Approving promotion to 100% if no issues in the next 30m.

deploy-bot: rollout progressed: 25% -> 100% (17:10 UTC). Promotion complete. Release v1.14.0 promoted to prod.

alex: Great work team. Next steps: update changelog final, notify customer success, tag the release in the release tracker, and schedule a post-mortem if any issues crop up.

jen: Notifying CS now. Sending release notes to #announcements after a quick proofread.

ryan: I'll close the hotfix branch and forward-port the redis pin to main. Commands: `git checkout main && git merge --no-ff rc/1.14.0-pin-redis && git push origin main`

maria: Thanks everyone. Marking RC -> Prod flow as complete. :rocket:

alex: Adding a small follow-up item — re-run our load test with the pinned redis client under 1000 RPS to catch any hidden regressions. I'll create a ticket.

sylvia: Added ticket INF-4823 for the load test.

deploy-bot: note: release artifact archived at s3://redwood-artifacts/1.14.0 · retention 90d

alex: thread closed.
